483-3220-4279--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
483-3220-4279--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Cruel Celebrant, Golgari Germination and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Cruel Celebrant trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Golgari Germination ability, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Cruel Celebrant triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

6495-6972-8174.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Mabel.
When Mabel dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Mabel enters, it triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.
6495-6972-8174.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

uses.n: Esika, God of the Tree // The Prismatic Bridge

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-2158-2301-3249--52.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-2158-2301-3249--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Esika by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, Abzan Ascendancy triggers, creating a creature token or a token that adds mana.
If you created a creature token, repeat steps 1 and 2 to sacrifice that token and add an additional mana.
If you created a token that adds mana, instead activate that token to add mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the sacrificed creature from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature from your graveyard by paying one mana.
Repeat.

261-3375-4399-4770.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and The Immortal Sun.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Suture Priest triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Whitemane Lion. When it enters, it and Suture Priest trigger.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Suture Priest trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
261-3375-4399-4770.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Whitemane Lion for the first time.

1309-1987-6747.easyPrerequisites: You control an artifact, creature or land that can enter and tap to produce at least {U}
1309-1987-6747.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two artifacts.
1309-1987-6747.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, blinking the mana-producing permanent and Salvager of Secrets.
When Salvager of Secrets enters, it triggers, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
1309-1987-6747.notes: You must blink a land as your mana-producing permanent to get infinite landfall triggers.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

27-1322-3259.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
27-1322-3259.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Sun-Blessed Guardian // Furnace-Blessed Conqueror as attackers.
Sun-Blessed Guardian // Furnace-Blessed Conqueror triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

628-997-7195.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Chaos Spewer.
When Chaos Spewer dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Chaos Spewer enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability
Repeat.

250-779-1479-5411-5671.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
250-779-1479-5411-5671.notablePrerequisites: You have a number of cards in hand that is above your maximum hand size, one of which must be a land card.
250-779-1479-5411-5671.description:
Play Dakmor Salvage.
When Dakmor Salvage enters, The Necrobloom and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Need for Speed by sacrificing Dakmor Salvage.
The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
If a land was milled this way, The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Need for Speed ability
Resolve the The Necrobloom trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Dakmor Salvage from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dakmor Salvage enters the battlefield, The Necrobloom triggers.
Repeat from step 4.
Proceed to your cleanup step, and discard a land and any other card(s) as needed down to your maximum hand size.
The Gitrog Monster triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return a land from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat, as you will still be over your maximum hand size and will be required to discard again.

57-283-3480-4846.notablePrerequisites: You control any number of permanents that enter untapped and that can collectively tap to produce at least {2}{R}.
57-283-3480-4846.description:
Activate any number of permanents by tapping them, adding at least {2}{R}.
Activate Feldon by paying {2}{R} and tapping it, targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Illusionist's Bracers triggers, copying Feldon's ability targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Resolve the copy of Feldon's ability, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
Resolve the Feldon ability from step 2, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token created in step 4 leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning all cards exiled with it to the battlefield.
Repeat.

539-5412-7032.description:
Cast Dai Li Agents by paying its mana cost
When Dai Li Agents enters, its earthbend ability triggers, causing it to earthbend itself as it is a Forest due to Ashaya.
Activate Coastal Hornclaw by sacrificing Dai Li Agents
When Dai Li Agents dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Dai Li Agents enters, its earthbend ability triggers, causing it to earthbend itself as it is a Forest due to Ashaya.
Resolve the Coastal Hornclaw ability.
Repeat from step 3.

1495-6260-6919.description:
Cast Strength of Will by paying {1}{G}, targeting Triskelion.
Activate Triskelion by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to it.
Triskelion triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to Caradora.
Activate Triskelion by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat from step 2.
1495-6260-6919.notes: You can skip step 4 if desired.

3841-4050-4484-6896.easyPrerequisites: A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich has died this turn.
3841-4050-4484-6896.description:
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {B}{B} due to Green Goblin.
Torens triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature token and Ebondeath, adding {B}{B}.
Repeat.

225-539-3257-6628.description:
Activate PuPu UFO by tapping it, putting Rakdos Carnarium from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Rakdos Carnarium enters, it and Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger.
Resolve the Rakdos Carnarium trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping PuPu UFO as it is a land due to Ashaya.
Repeat.

1251-2457-3000-4289.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the creature tokens by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat

603-5470-6798.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to create a creature token this turn.
Galvanic Juggernaut is untapped and does not have summoning sickness.
603-5470-6798.description:
Create a creature token.
Activate Galvanic Juggernaut by tapping it, creating a copy of the creature token.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing a creature token.
When the creature token dies, Galvanic Juggernaut triggers, untapping itself.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability
Repeat from step 2.

3951-4365-4452-5703.easyPrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill Altaïr
3951-4365-4452-5703.description:
Declare Altaïr as an attacker, triggering its ability, exiling Éomer from your graveyard with a memory counter on it and creating two tapped and attacking copies of Éomer.
Put all but one Éomer token into your graveyard due to the legend rule, causing you to get at least one Éomer trigger, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
At the end of your combat phase, Altaïr triggers, causing you to exile the Éomer token.
Repeat each combat phase.

2425-2511-6249--5.notablePrerequisites: The persist creature does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
2425-2511-6249--5.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, it and Smothering Abomination trigger.
Resolve the Smothering Abomination trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the persist creature's trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters the battlefield, Olivia triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature and causing you to discard a card.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

4484-5147-6440.notablePrerequisites: A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich died this turn.
4484-5147-6440.description:
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Ebondeath.
Repeat.

997-2060-2744-3327.notablePrerequisites: You have sacrificed at least three artifacts and/or creatures this turn, plus an additional artifact or creature for each time you've cast Dargo from the command zone this game.
997-2060-2744-3327.description:
Cast Dargo from the command zone by paying {R}.
When Dargo enters the battlefield, Cathars' Crusade triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Dargo.
Choose to return Dargo from your graveyard to the command zone.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability, causing you to scry 1.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {R}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-3682-4518-5542.description:
Cast Mox Amber by paying {0}.
Birgi triggers, adding {R}.
Activate Mox Amber by tapping it, adding {W}.
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {1}{W}.
Birgi triggers, adding {R}.
When Kor Skyfisher enters the battlefield, it triggers twice due to Delney, returning Mox Amber and Kor Skyfisher from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

3168-3859-4452-5613.notablePrerequisites: "Samurai" chosen with Urza's Incubator and Rukarumel.
3168-3859-4452-5613.description:
Cast Cavern Harpy by paying {0}.
When Cavern Harpy enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

2136-2178-5221-5231.notablePrerequisites:
Orthion does not have summoning sickness.
Thornbite Staff attached to Orthion.
2136-2178-5221-5231.description:
Activate Orthion's first ability by paying {1}{R} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Sprouting Thrinax with haste.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing the Sprouting Thrinax token, adding {R}.
When the Sprouting Thrinax token dies, it and Orthion trigger.
Resolve the Orthion trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Sprouting Thrinax trigger, creating three 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing a Saproling, adding {R}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite Saprolings, you may forego sacrificing the Sprouting Thrinax tokens.
You may also then use Orthion's second ability targeting any creature you control.

3259-5348.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-5348.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Harried Dronesmith triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

579-1194-2816.notablePrerequisites:
Knotvine Mystic does not have summoning sickness.
Umbral Mantle attached to Knotvine Mystic.
579-1194-2816.description:
Activate Knotvine Mystic by paying {1} and tapping it, adding {R}{R}{G}{G}{W}{W}.
Activate Knotvine Mystic by paying {3} and untapping it, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat.

628-2034-2080-3944-4823.notablePrerequisites:
Blood Pet does not have a +1/+1 counter on it.
You control another nontoken non-Human creature that does not have a +1/+1 counter on it.
628-2034-2080-3944-4823.description:
Activate Blood Pet by sacrificing it, adding {B}.
When Blood Pet dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it to the battlefield from your graveyard with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Blood Pet by sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing Timeless Witness and another nontoken non-Human creature, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
When the non-Human creature dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it to the battlefield from your graveyard with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing Mikaeus and the non-Human creature, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Cast Rise of the Dark Realms by paying {7}{B}{B}, putting all creature cards from all graveyards onto the battlefield under your control.
When Timeless Witness enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Living Death to your hand from your graveyard.
Repeat.

3018-3560-4050.description:
Cast Rancor by paying {G}, attaching it to any other creature you control.
When Rancor enters, Archon of Sun's Grace triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature with Rancor attached, adding {G}.
Rancor triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1176-2341.notablePrerequisites:
Enchanted permanents you control can tap to produce at least {2}.
Estrid is not your commander.
The Peregrine Dynamo is enchanted.
1176-2341.description:
Activate Estrid's first loyalty ability by putting two loyalty counters on it.
Holding priority, activate all mana-producing enchanted permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate The Peregrine Dynamo by paying {1} and tapping it, copying Estrid's ability.
Resolve the copy of Estrid's ability, untapping all enchanted permanents you control.
Repeat from step 2.

1339-1689-3923-4050.description:
Cast Mystic Speculation with buyback by paying {2}{U}, causing you to draw three cards due to Eligeth and return Mystic Speculation to your hand.
The Locust God triggers three times, creating three 1/1 Insect creature tokens with flying and haste.
Activate Phyrexian Altar three times by sacrificing the three Insects, adding {2}{U}.
Repeat.

553-1403-3212-3736.notablePrerequisites: Survivor of the Unseen does not have summoning sickness.
553-1403-3212-3736.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Survivor of the Unseen's cumulative upkeep ability triggers.
In response, tap Survivor the Unseen to activate it, drawing two cards, revealing Approach of the Second Sun as you draw it, triggering God-Eternal Kefnet, and putting Approach of the Second Sun on top of your library.
Resolve God-Eternal Kefnet's trigger, copying Approach of the Second Sun and casting it by paying {4}{W}.
Sunbird's Invocation triggers, revealing the top seven cards of your library, casting Approach of the Second Sun without paying its mana cost, then putting the rest of the revealed cards on the bottom of your library.
Resolve Approach of the Second Sun, putting it back into your library seventh from the top and gaining you 7 life.
Resolve the remaining copy of Approach of the Second Sun.

1561-1972.description:
Cast Peer into the Abyss by paying {4}{B}{B}{B}, causing an opponent to draw cards equal to half their library and causing them to lose half their life total, rounded up.
Nekusar triggers for each card drawn this way.
Resolve the first trigger, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
If the opponent has 0 or less life, the opponent loses the game due to having zero or less life.
Repeat from step 3 for each remaining trigger and/or until the opponent loses the game.
